method: Exact MuJoCo ray intersection along all native 8x8 pixel-center directions. Same geometry mask as skin depth renderer (robot hidden, sensor-only geometry enabled). Native 8x8 raster depths also exported.
display: All 2560 rays submitted to MuJoCo renderer, subject to camera framing and occlusion. Orange emphasizes intersections with actual cup and clutter; teal shows structural returns. Outer-room rays are faint. No accumulated or invented samples. Sensor-only geometry mask excludes the arm; pedestal remains visible to sensing.
validation: 40 unique sensors; exactly 64 unit ray directions per sensor; all 2560 intersections finite and positive. Endpoints match origin + range times direction.
